notes: THE LOOK update: the FL Studio window layout wearing the 2X skin — Browser left, Playlist centre, Channel Rack over the playlist, Mixer along the bottom, gel-gloss controls and smooth modern type throughout. New Theme engine: your own colours, background picture and playlist watermark, plus 7 presets. Bonus modes Cali Experience LA, Cali Experience Ice and 2X Cali Tuxedo Mode included — unlock them by linking your HERE account in Settings. Also carries every v1.3.0 feature: 44 effects, 15 instruments, VST2 hosting, Cali AI assistant, stem separation and AI mastering.
